##### Project general facts

Shahrukhz Residences is a waterfront residential tower inspired by Shah Rukh Khan and built around the idea of living life king style. A sculpted façade with flowing curves and warm metallic accents rises above the sea, while every level is oriented towards open water and the city skyline. The collection spans studios and flexible studios, one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, King's layouts with signature dressing areas, and a separate wing of Ocean Residences with larger suites set closer to the water.

Residents enjoy an extensive programme of amenities spread across a lifestyle deck, a wellness deck and a sky deck. The podium brings together a children's water park, a dancing fountain, padel, basketball and cricket courts, cabanas, a sensory garden and barbecue areas. A wellness floor features an infinity pool, a fully equipped gym and a longevity lounge with cryotherapy, hyperbaric oxygen therapy, red light therapy and a salt room, while indoor spaces include a private cinema, a podcast studio, a business centre, a dance studio, a golf simulator and a kids' play area, crowned by a rooftop clubhouse and outdoor deck.

All residences are delivered fully furnished, with floor-to-ceiling glazing that frames uninterrupted sea views. Thoughtful planning adds convertible layouts, multipurpose rooms, dual-access bathrooms and dedicated laundry areas in selected homes, while King's units include generous wardrobe and dressing suites finished in refined, light-toned materials.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Maritime City is a waterfront district on a man-made peninsula between Port Rashid and the historic heart of Bur Dubai. The district is shaped as a lifestyle destination by the sea, close to Port Rashid, the Dubai Cruise Terminal, Dubai World Trade Centre and Jumeirah Beach.

The peninsula connects quickly to Sheikh Zayed Road, Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa and The Dubai Mall, while Dubai International Airport and Palm Jumeirah remain within easy reach. The community plan includes a planned metro station, a proposed shopping mall, a beach, a sunset promenade, a sports park, a cable car, a sky walk bridge and a mosque, adding everyday convenience along the water.

Waterfront living close to the main business and tourism hubs of Dubai continues to attract professionals, families and holiday renters. Dubai Maritime City combines this appeal with its central coastal position and growing community infrastructure, supporting steady demand for both long-term rentals and premium short-stay homes.
